title: Trade-Offs Between Fairness and Privacy in Language Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using three benchmarks: BEC-Pro (comparing the probability of male versus female tokens in sentences related to professions), SEAT (computing the differential association between gendered terms/names and stereotypical concepts like career/family or math/arts using sentence embeddings), and StereoSet (evaluating the model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical contextual associations).
